newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - PanEnergy seen up.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - PanEnergy seen up.

text.p: Duke Power Co's $7.7 billion takeover of PanEnergy Corp raised bids for PanEnergy shares to 44-1/2 ahead of Monday's market open, up two from Friday's close, while Duke was offered 1/4 lower at 47-5/8.

Under the defintive, stock-swap deal, each PanEnergy share would be converted into 1.044 Duke Power shares. In dollars, the deal values PanEnergy at $50 per share, based on Duke's Friday closing share price of $47-7/8, off 1/4.
PanEnergy share closed Friday at 42-1/4, up 1-5/8. During the session, the shares hit a new all-time high of 42-3/8.
In other deal-related traded, Opal Inc shares soared to 18-1/8 from 12-1/8 after Applied Materials Inc said it will acquire Opal for $175 million.
Based on Opal's roughly 8.74 million common shares and Friday's 12-1/8 close, the market cap is about $106 million.
Applied shares traded higher after the news, to 39 from 38-5/8.
Applied's bid values Opal at $18.50 per share.
Investors fled from Chiron Corp early Monday after the company said data from genital herpes vaccine trials do not indicate efficacy and that the company will abandon attempts to license the product.
The shares fell to 19-3/8 from 21-7/8 in vigorous pre-open dealing.
MCI Communications Corp shares rose to 30-1/2 from 29-3/4, gains related to the rise in the shares of MCI's merger partner British Telecomm in London Stock Exchange trade Monday.
American Woodmark shares are poised to rise at the opening bell after the company reported fiscal second quarter earnings of $0.45 per share versus $0.08 per share one year-ago.
The consensus earnings forecast according to Zack's Investment Research was $0.30 per share.
American Woodmark share were bid 9-5/8, ask 9-3/4, up from Friday's 8-7/8 Nasdaq close.
